Ask ELUXIOR

The portal answers only when an approved ELUXIOR source supports the response. The current PO and later authorised TJX instructions prevail.

Please submit your questions in English. This helps the portal identify the correct ELUXIOR guidance and provide the most reliable answer.

Vendor account administration

Visible only to ELUXIOR administrators. Create vendor accounts, reset temporary passwords and enable or disable access.

Do not enter passwords, banking credentials, secret keys or other confidential authentication information into the question box. If the portal cannot ground an answer in an approved source, contact ELUXIOR directly.
